promptLatex: Two sides of triangle $ABC$ form an angle of $65^{\circ}$ at $A$ and an angle of $47^{\circ}$ at $B$. What is the measure, in degrees, of $m\angle C$?
hintLatex: All three interior angles of a triangle are fixed once two of them are known.
Add the two known measures and remove the sum from a straight angle.
solutionLatex:
The interior angles of any triangle sum to $180^{\circ}$, whatever shape the triangle has.

The two known angles already account for $65^{\circ} + 47^{\circ} = 112^{\circ}$.

What remains is $m\angle C = 180^{\circ} - 112^{\circ} = 68^{\circ}$.
